note: BH-9435: the Node heap (MB) of a harness typecheck (the post-rebase verify in bin/lib/rb/pr.sh, bin/rebase-train.sh, bin/pool-toolchain-probe.sh) for one project. Per project: lane.fly-pool.<project>.tsc_heap_mb. 0 = no row: rebase_tsc_heap falls through to env TSC_HEAP_MB, then 70% of RAM capped at 12288 (a repo workflow's heap only when larger), then 6144 when RAM is unreadable.
